This small plot is rented, so I cannot spend too much on it. Cassava and yam grow well here in the South South with our good rains, and I usually rely on the bush fallow and small heaps of household manure rather than buying expensive fertilizer. I will use cuttings and seed yams I saved from last season — improved varieties are hard to find and costly for a rented plot. My children and I will do most of the work, but I will hire a few hands for making the heaps and weeding.
